posting_disposition_kind_reason_check.name: posting_disposition_kind_reason_check
posting_disposition_kind_reason_check.value:
("posting_disposition"."kind" = 'set_aside' AND "posting_disposition"."set_aside_reason_id" IS NOT NULL AND "posting_disposition"."rejection_reason_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("posting_disposition"."kind" = 'rejected' AND "posting_disposition"."rejection_reason_id" IS NOT NULL AND "posting_disposition"."set_aside_reason_id" IS NULL)

posting_score_agent_reason_needs_verdict.name: posting_score_agent_reason_needs_verdict_check
posting_score_agent_reason_needs_verdict.value: "posting_score"."agent_verdict" IS NOT NULL OR "posting_score"."agent_reason" IS NULL

public.pending_rescore.definition:
select "rescore_request"."id" as "rescore_request_id", "posting"."id" as "posting_id" from "rescore_request" inner join "posting" on "posting"."seen_at" >= "rescore_request"."since_date" where not exists (
        select 1 from "posting_score"
        where ("posting_score"."posting_id" = "posting"."id" and "posting_score"."criteria_set_id" = "rescore_request"."criteria_set_id")
      )
public.pending_rescore.name: pending_rescore

public.posting_first_touch.definition: select distinct on ("origin"."posting_id") "posting_id", "id" as "origin_id", "route_id", "touched_on" from "origin" where "origin"."posting_id" IS NOT NULL AND "origin"."touched_on" <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc')::date order by "origin"."posting_id", "origin"."touched_on", "origin"."recorded_at", "origin"."id"
public.posting_first_touch.name: posting_first_touch
